The Cavaliers defeated the Mavericks, 127-117 tonight in Cleveland. Tyrese Proctor finished with a team-high 24 points along with 11 rebounds and 10 assists for the Cavaliers, while Mario Hezonja tallied 22 points, 7 rebounds and 4 assists in the game. Kyrie Irving recorded 34 points, 7 three pointers and 6 rebounds. The Cavaliers improve their record to 7-7 with the win, while the Mavericks fall to 7-6 for the season.
